title: Mini Golf 3D
desc: Mini Golf 3D is a smooth arcade golf game with more than 40 progressively harder levels. Aim, charge your shot, avoid sand and water hazards, and master compact courses with clean physics.
howto: Click or tap to start aiming.
Set the shot direction and power.
Avoid hazards that slow the ball or cost strokes.
Earn gems and unlock new colored balls as you progress.
tips: Plan around hazards before choosing power.
Use lighter shots near sand traps and water.
A clean angle into a wall can open blocked holes.
Replay early levels to learn how hard each power level hits.
